result.reason: The addition is targeted and preserves the existing commercial terms, while adding professional-and-workmanlike performance, a 12-month software conformance warranty, malicious-code protection, legal compliance, and repair/re-performance/replacement/refund remedies. However, it provides no 90-day warranty period for services, as required by the preferred position (or the 30-day fallback). The margin comment acknowledges the missing duration but does not cure the operative language. Drafting is generally professional, though “following delivery” may be unclear for hosted software and “Client's remedy ... is” may inadvertently create an exclusive remedy.
